# SGAI Proxy (`eyevinn-sgai-ad-proxy`)

Boost viewer engagement with our Server-Guided Ad Insertion Proxy! Automatically embed ads into video streams with precision timing. Enhance monetization effortlessly while maintaining a seamless user experience.

[Service documentation](https://docs.osaas.io/osaas.wiki/Service%3A-SGAI-Proxy.html) · [Source](https://github.com/Eyevinn/sgai-ad-proxy)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "eyevinn-sgai-ad-proxy"
  name       = "myproxy"

  parameters = {
    VastEndpoint          = "..."
    OriginHost            = "..."
    InsertionMode         = "..."
    # OriginUrl             = "..."
    # DefaultAdDuration     = "..."
    # DefaultRepeatingCycle = "..."
    # DefaultAdNumber       = "..."
    # TestAssetUrl          = "..."
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VastEndpoint` | string | yes | The VAST 4.0/4.1 XML compatible ad server endpoint URL that provides advertisement content |
| `OriginHost` | string | yes | The hostname or IP address of the origin HLS streaming server that provides the source video content |
| `OriginUrl` | string | no | The complete URL to the master playlist of the origin HLS stream |
| `InsertionMode` | string | yes | The ad insertion mode to use for placing advertisements in the stream |
| `DefaultAdDuration` | string | no | The default duration in seconds for ad breaks when not specified |
| `DefaultRepeatingCycle` | string | no | The interval in seconds at which ad breaks repeat in static insertion mode |
| `DefaultAdNumber` | string | no | The default number of ad slots to generate in static insertion mode |
| `TestAssetUrl` | string | no | A test asset URL to replace raw MP4 assets with a fragmented MP4 VoD media playlist for better compatibility |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
